sec.title: August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 140)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American network, Stan Kenton and Gerry Mulligan exploring progressive jazz on NBC, William Gargan solving a backstage murder in Himan Brown's *Barrie Craig, Confidential Investigator*, Dennis O'Keefe busting a counterfeiting art foundation on *T-Man*, Alexander Scourby hosting Arturo Toscanini's immortal Studio 8H NBC Symphony performances, Joe DeSantis hunting a hit-and-run assassin on *Under Arrest*, and Penny Winters aiding Freddie on *Hearts in Harmony* for Kroger (1946–1959):
